description: DELETES the database and its data; billing stops. Ask the user first. confirm_name must be the database's exact name. Its backups stay 7 days (restore_database can bring it back meanwhile). Refused while a linked fork depends on it. Scope: vms.destroy.

confirm_name.description: The database's exact name, typed back as confirmation.

database.description: Database id, as returned by list_databases or create_database.

name: delete_database
title: Delete a database
